component.name: OSM Ride
component.summary: Indoor trainer companion with live GPX route replay

description.p: OSM Ride connects to a BLE smart trainer (FTMS or CSC) and replays a pre-loaded GPX route on a 3D map as you pedal, tracking distance, power, cadence, and heart rate. Structured .erg/.mrc/.zwo workouts drive ERG mode, and finished rides export as GPX for Strava.
This is the Linux desktop counterpart to the OSM Ride Android app, sharing the same BLE protocol handling and file formats.
Initial self-hosted release: BLE trainer/HR pairing, ride history, settings, route and workout import, the route creator (tap-to-route via BRouter), and the workout creator.
